subject: Amendment Request: Draft Bill of Lading Discrepancies
body:
Dear Partner,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction, which serves as our authoritative reference.

Please amend the following discrepancies to match the Shipping Instruction:
- Consignee: Shipping Instruction = EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC | draft Bill of Lading = UAB NOVAKOPA
- Notify Party: Shipping Instruction = EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC | draft Bill of Lading = UAB NOVAKOPA

Kindly send us the updated draft at your earliest convenience.

Sincerely,
Shipping Operations
